verdict.rationale: The official `sv` CLI scaffolds a project with `npx sv create myapp`, followed by `npm install` and `npm run dev` to run it. The CLI also offers `sv add` to extend a project and can create a full SvelteKit project from a playground URL, which covers both scaffolding and running. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the 'few minutes' setup time (the only community comment on getting started is an older complaint that install info was hard to find).
